description: This file defines various classes, attributes, interfaces, and structs related to Orleans.BroadcastChannel, including channel options, channel ID representation, namespace predicates, and provider interfaces. It appears to be part of a larger Orleans-based streaming or broadcasting system.

classes.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to declare implicit channel subscriptions with optional predicate or namespace pattern.

classes.name: RegexImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute
classes.description: Derived attribute class to specify regex-based namespace pattern for implicit subscriptions.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for broadcast channels, e.g., whether to use fire-and-forget delivery.

classes.name: ChannelId
classes.description: Immutable struct representing a channel identifier with namespace and key, supporting comparison and serialization.

classes.name: ConstructorChannelNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Provides channel namespace predicates based on constructor pattern.

classes.name: DefaultChannelIdMapper
classes.description: Default implementation of IChannelIdMapper that generates grain key IDs from stream IDs.

methods.name: GetBindings
methods.description: Generates bindings based on services, class type, and grain type for implicit subscription attributes.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create a ChannelId from namespace and key (bytes, string, or Guid).

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this ChannelId to another for ordering.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality between two ChannelId instances.

methods.name: GetKeyAsString
methods.description: Returns the stream key as a string.

methods.name: GetNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace as a string.

methods.name: Operators
methods.description: Equality and inequality operators for ChannelId.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ChannelId.

methods.name: FormatPattern
methods.description: Formats a predicate pattern string for namespace predicates.

methods.name: TryGetPredicate
methods.description: Attempts to parse a predicate pattern string into an IChannelNamespacePredicate.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Publishes an item via the broadcast channel writer.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches subscription handlers for a broadcast channel.

methods.name: GetChannelWriter
methods.description: Retrieves a channel writer for a specific stream ID.

methods.name: GetBroadcastChannelProvider
methods.description: Extension method to get a broadcast channel provider from a cluster client.
